name: smwgraphics-peachette-super-crown-cape-replacement
title: Peachette / Super Crown (Cape Replacement)
description:
A Peachette GFX I made to replace ONLY the cape power-up. I also added a super crown to replace the feather sprite, both are compatible with SMW's original palette.

Note that it requires a few ASM edits if you want these graphics to appear when Mario gets the power-up, and recreate the abilities of the original power-up from NSMBU deluxe, so it comes with two patches.
Be sure to read the readme too.

Please give credits if used !
